correctness.rationale: Two independent exhaustive forest predicates agree on all 2^14 vertex masks and exactly 12,792 faces. A deterministic 6,392-pair matching has eight critical dimension-eight simplices and a complete acyclic 81,648-incidence Hasse graph. The augmented empty-face removal yields one critical vertex and eight eight-cells, so the integral homotopy wedge follows. All 168 point–line-preserving matrices act simplicially; direct signed Lefschetz calculations agree elementwise with the connected building graph H1 character, giving rational isomorphism, character norm one and no invariant line.

value.rationale: The induced-forest complex is the endpoint of a motivated standard graph-complex filtration. Complete integral homotopy on the canonical Heawood incidence graph plus identification of the 168-element symmetry action with the irreducible Steinberg module is a natural structural classification; it is not merely the known building Betti number, a renaming, or an arbitrary choice of parameters. This supplies an explicit topological realization linking graph acyclicity complexes and finite buildings.
